# Vendored Lucide icons
Retrieved 2026-11-09 from the official Lucide repository:
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/main/icons/message-square.svg
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/main/icons/hash.svg
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/main/LICENSE
Original SVGs and complete ISC/MIT notices are included. icons.js adapts the identical SVG nodes for React, with no redrawn geometry. No network request or third-party script executes at runtime.
